description: DHNP Vitamin C is a high-concentration ascorbic acid injection manufactured in South Korea for parenteral vitamin C therapy in a clinical setting. It is widely used in aesthetic and wellness practice for antioxidant support and skin-brightening protocols, and is frequently combined with glutathione infusions. Each ampoule delivers a high therapeutic dose intended for intravenous, intramuscular or subcutaneous administration by a clinician.
howItWorks: Ascorbic acid acts as a potent water-soluble antioxidant, neutralising reactive oxygen species generated by UV exposure and metabolic stress. It is an essential cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase enzymes in collagen synthesis, and it modulates melanogenesis by interfering with tyrosinase-driven melanin formation. Parenteral delivery bypasses gastrointestinal absorption limits to achieve higher plasma concentrations than oral dosing.
composition: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) 10,000 mg per 20 mL ampoule (500 mg/mL).
usageNotes: For intravenous, intramuscular or subcutaneous use under medical supervision; higher IV doses are typically diluted in a compatible carrier solution and infused slowly. Reported label guidance is 50-1,000 mg/day divided into one or more doses. Store protected from light in a cool place. Screen for G6PD deficiency, renal impairment and history of oxalate nephrolithiasis before high-dose IV use. Confirm local regulatory registration before import or clinical use.

As an enzymatic cofactor it contributes to collagen hydroxylation, and it can inhibit tyrosinase activity involved in melanin synthesis. Intravenous or intramuscular delivery raises circulating vitamin C beyond levels achievable orally.

description: DHNP Bicolamin is a water-soluble B-vitamin injection from Daehan New Pharm of South Korea, based on cobalamin (vitamin B12) in the hydroxocobalamin form. It is used within B-vitamin and wellness infusion protocols to support energy, neurological function and general revitalisation. The product is supplied as single-use ampoules for clinician-administered IV or IM use.
howItWorks: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) is an essential cofactor for methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, enzymes central to DNA synthesis, red-cell formation and myelin maintenance. Adequate B12 supports normal haematopoiesis and nervous-system function, and repletion can address fatigue and neurological symptoms associated with deficiency. Parenteral delivery bypasses the intrinsic-factor absorption pathway required for oral B12 uptake.
composition: Hydroxocobalamin (vitamin B12); reported at approximately 5 mg per 2 mL ampoule (supplied as 2 mL x 50 ampoules). Confirm exact strength against the current manufacturer label.
usageNotes: For IM (preferred) or IV administration under medical supervision. Protect from light. Vitamin B12 injections are generally well tolerated; assess for cobalt/cobalamin hypersensitivity and monitor in patients with pre-existing conditions per local practice. Verify local regulatory registration and current labelled strength before import and clinical use.

description: Mesocartin is an injectable L-carnitine solution manufactured in South Korea and marketed for metabolic and body-contouring support. Each ampoule provides a high dose of pharmaceutical L-carnitine intended for clinician-administered IV or IM use. It is positioned within weight-management, energy and metabolic wellness protocols.
howItWorks: L-carnitine is a naturally occurring amino-acid derivative that shuttles long-chain fatty acids across the mitochondrial membrane, where they undergo beta-oxidation to generate cellular energy. By facilitating fatty-acid transport it supports lipid metabolism and energy production. Clinically it is also used to correct L-carnitine deficiency, including in end-stage renal disease patients on haemodialysis.
composition: L-carnitine 2,000 mg (2 g) per 10 mL ampoule; supplied as 10 mL x 10 ampoules.
usageNotes: For IV or IM administration under medical supervision; professional use only. A commonly cited regimen is 1-2 ampoules per week with at least a five-day interval between doses, adjusted to the individual. Store at room temperature, protected from light. Assess renal function and seizure history before use. Verify local regulatory registration before import and clinical use.

description: Laennec is a human placenta hydrolysate injection manufactured by Japan Bio Products Co., Ltd. (JBP) using proprietary extraction technology. In Japan it is a long-established pharmaceutical whose approved indication is improvement of hepatic function in chronic hepatic disease, and it is also used internationally in revitalisation and anti-ageing protocols. As a human-derived biologic, its regulatory status and permitted use vary significantly by country.
howItWorks: Laennec is a water-soluble hydrolysate of human placenta containing low-molecular-weight peptides, amino acids, nucleic acid components, trace elements and other bioactive constituents. It is marketed for cellular revitalisation and hepatic support, with proposed activity in supporting tissue repair and metabolic function. Mechanistic claims for placental extracts remain an area of ongoing study and vary by jurisdiction.
composition: Water-soluble human placenta hydrolysate 112 mg per 2 mL ampoule.
usageNotes: Administered subcutaneously or intramuscularly under medical supervision; the standard adult dose is 2 mL once daily, increased to 2-3 times daily according to symptoms per the manufacturer. IMPORTANT: as a human placenta-derived biologic, regulatory status differs by country - it is restricted or unapproved in some jurisdictions, and recipients may face blood/plasma donation deferral in certain countries. Verify national regulatory approval, import rules and donation-deferral implications before any clinical use.

description: Zinc-S is an injectable zinc preparation formulated as a trace-element supplement for parenteral nutrition. It supplies zinc, an essential cofactor for numerous enzymes and immune and skin functions, for patients in whom oral or enteral intake is inadequate or not advised. It is intended as a component of clinician-supervised nutritional admixtures rather than as a stand-alone bolus injection.
howItWorks: Zinc is an essential trace element and cofactor for over 300 enzymes involved in protein synthesis, cell division, wound healing, immune function and antioxidant defence (as a structural component of superoxide dismutase). Repletion supports normal enzymatic and immune activity where dietary intake is insufficient. Parenteral supplementation ensures availability during total parenteral nutrition.
composition: Zinc sulfate hydrate 4.4 mg/mL; supplied as 5 mL vials (10 vials per pack).
usageNotes: Intended to be added to parenteral nutrition admixtures rather than given as a direct undiluted IV push; a commonly cited TPN maintenance range is approximately 2.5-4 mg elemental zinc per day, adjusted for clinical status. Prepared and administered under medical/pharmacy supervision as part of a compounded nutritional solution. Verify local regulatory registration and compounding practice before use.

description: Maxiblue 5 Inj. is a Korean multi-trace-element injection combining five essential minerals - zinc, copper, manganese, selenium and chromium - for use during parenteral nutrition and micronutrient support. It is positioned for antioxidant and metabolic wellness protocols, delivering trace elements that serve as cofactors for antioxidant and metabolic enzymes. It is intended for clinician-supervised parenteral use.
howItWorks: The five trace elements act as enzymatic cofactors: selenium and manganese support antioxidant enzymes (glutathione peroxidase and superoxide dismutase respectively), zinc and copper contribute to immune function and antioxidant defence, and chromium participates in glucose and insulin-related metabolism. Together they support cellular antioxidant capacity, enzyme activity and metabolic balance. Parenteral delivery ensures availability where dietary or oral intake is insufficient.
composition: Combination of five trace elements: zinc sulfate hydrate, cupric sulfate hydrate, manganese sulfate hydrate, selenious acid (selenium) and chromic chloride hydrate. Supplied as 10 mL vials. Per-element strengths should be confirmed against the current manufacturer label.
usageNotes: For addition to parenteral nutrition admixtures and clinician-supervised infusion rather than undiluted bolus injection. Administer as part of a compounded nutritional solution with attention to cumulative trace-element intake from other sources to avoid accumulation (particularly manganese and copper in hepatic/cholestatic patients). Verify local regulatory registration and per-element dosing before clinical use.
